title: Inside US-Saudi nuclear deal: Why Pakistan is biggest loser
content: The newly forged nuclear pact between the US and Saudi Arabia promises to transform the atomic dynamics in the region. This agreement grants Saudi Arabia the ability to enrich uranium domestically, supervised by the United States, effectively diminishing Pakistan's nuclear dominance. The emergence of a nuclear triangle comprising Israel, Iran, and Saudi Arabia signals a significant shift in U.S. non-proliferation efforts, embracing a tiered regional order.

title: Rahul's 'advice' to PM Modi, and 3 guarantees to students over police action on protesters
content: Rahul Gandhi accused the Centre of denying him Lok Sabha speech rights. He refused to apologize for blaming Amit Shah for police brutality. Gandhi demanded the Home Minister's dismissal and an independent probe. He alleged police used pellet guns and nail-fitted lathis on students. Gandhi promised justice and accountability for the injured students.

title: India faces 100% Trump tariff threat as US Senate advances Russia Sanctions Bill - what it means
content: India has stepped up Russian crude oil purchases to make up for the deficit, helped in part by the US sanctions waiver which lapsed recently. However, India has continued to procure Russian crude.

title: Sooryavanshi jumps 230 places in T20I rankings as Ishan Kishan scripts history
content: Teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has jumped 230 places in the ICC T20I batting rankings. Ishan Kishan retains his world number one position with a historic rating. Tilak Varma and Shreyas Iyer also saw gains in the rankings. Ravi Bishnoi made significant progress in the T20I bowling rankings. Zimbabwe's Ryan Burl and Blessing Muzarabani also achieved career-best rankings.

title: JPMorgan CEO recalls his Citigroup firing: Shares meeting with mentor Sandy Weill
content: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon discussed two major life events.  His 1998 Citigroup dismissal reshaped his career path significantly. His youngest daughter asked if the family would now have to “sleep on the streets”. A near-fatal heart emergency in 2020 brought him peace.  Dimon invested heavily in Bank One after leaving Citigroup.  This bold move led to his leadership at JPMorgan Chase.

title: 'Iran is going to get a beating': Trump threatens 'hard' response after attack on US base
content: United States President Donald Trump warned Iran of a forceful military response. American bases in Jordan faced missile attacks which the US intercepted. Iran's Revolutionary Guard claimed responsibility for the attempted surprise strike. US and Saudi forces also conducted overnight strikes against Iran-backed militias. Global markets reacted to the latest escalation in the Middle East.

title: How Europe's heatwave is proving Americans right about air conditioning
content: Europeans are now buying air conditioning units in unprecedented numbers. Manufacturers report significant sales growth across several European countries. This shift is driven by both comfort and public health concerns. Rising temperatures and extreme heat events are becoming impossible to ignore. Cultural attitudes towards cooling solutions are beginning to change.

title: Meet Abigail Stein, 13-year-old behind affordable allergy spoons
content: Abigail Stein developed an ingenious spoon designed to identify food allergens, providing a safety net for students with severe allergies during school meals. This innovative Allergy Spoon changes color upon detecting specific allergens, enhancing awareness and safety. Abigail was celebrated as a leading finalist in a prestigious young scientist challenge, with aspirations that her practical solution will address a significant concern for many families.

title: Honeybee diet change boosts pesticide survival from below 50% to 90%
content: New research suggests honey bees can better survive pesticide exposure.  Bees fed polyunsaturated fats showed a 90% survival rate.  This dietary fat type also supported nerve function and energy balance.  The findings indicate nutrition can strengthen bee resilience against agricultural stressors.  This knowledge could inform bee diets and pollinator habitat planning.

title: Sam Altman on Meta's AI Mark Zuckerberg: People don't want AI running companies
content: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman stated people want human accountability in company leadership.  Meta is reportedly developing an AI version of CEO Mark Zuckerberg for employee assistance.  This AI character will mimic Zuckerberg's mannerisms and public statements.  Altman previously suggested AI could lead companies but now emphasizes human connection.  He believes human judgment remains crucial in various professional fields.

title: Sonu Sood slams Kangana Ranaut's 'Generation Gutter' remark, says think before you speak
content: Sonu Sood has responded to Kangana Ranaut's controversial remarks about young protesters. He emphasized the significant role young people play in public figures' careers. Sood stated that these young individuals are crucial for actors' success and influence. He expressed disappointment with Ranaut's 'gutter' comment, calling it shameful. Sood advised weighing words carefully, as the public holds immense power.

title: ICC punishes Pakistan seamers after defeat against West Indies in first Test
content: Pakistan bowlers Mohammad Abbas and Khurram Shahzad faced ICC sanctions for code of conduct breaches. Shahzad received a fine and demerit point for his aggressive celebration after a dismissal. Abbas was officially reprimanded and given a demerit point for a similar on-field action. Both players accepted responsibility for their actions, concluding the process without formal hearings. This disciplinary action follows Pakistan's opening Test defeat against the West Indies.

title: CM Vijay mobbed by fans during Chennai Metro visit after 'Jana Nayagan' release
content: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay experienced immense fan excitement during a Chennai Metro visit. Hundreds of fans gathered, creating a massive crowd at the stations. Videos of the event went viral, showcasing his significant popularity. This reception mirrors the enthusiasm seen during his film releases. His farewell film 'Jana Nayagan' also continues its successful box office run.

title: ITR filing deadline nears: How to file income tax return online - quick 15-step guide
content: The process to file the income tax return has evolved over the last few years and the income tax portal now pre-fills a lot of your tax related information drawing from information in documents such as Form 16, Form 26AS, Annual Information Statement (AIS), bank records etc.

title: 'Been in Russia for 4 months': Bihar man questions being named in NEET protest FIR
content: While overseas, a Bihar citizen asserts that police have filed charges against him for a protest he did not attend, detailed in a video reportedly shot in Russia. In response, the Kishanganj SP invited individuals with concerns to contact the police. Furthermore, the state government plans to void all cases linked to the NEET paper leak protests and will release arrested individuals in light of this decision.

title: Why Australia coach is dreaming of Ben Stokes' 'fairytale' return for Ashes
content: Australian coach Andrew McDonald desires Ben Stokes' return for the 2027 Ashes series.  He believes this would create a compelling narrative for the cricket rivalry.  Stokes retired from Test cricket earlier this year after a home series defeat.  A new England coach might persuade him to reconsider his decision to play again.  Stokes has continued playing domestic cricket, showing he still has ability.

title: RCB become first IPL franchise to cross $300 million in brand value
content: Royal Challengers Bengaluru holds the IPL's top brand value at over $300 million. This valuation reflects strong performance and fan engagement, according to a recent study. The franchise's recent acquisition by a consortium highlights its significant market appeal. The Indian Premier League's overall business value also reached $20.6 billion. Mumbai Indians and Chennai Super Kings follow RCB in brand value rankings.

title: Voter card, Aadhaar, bank account, PAN not citizenship proof: Calcutta HC
content: Calcutta High Court stated voter cards and Aadhaar are not conclusive proof of Indian citizenship. The court refused to interfere in proceedings concerning a Murshidabad man held in a detention centre. Nasir and his cousin Suman Molla were given chances to prove his Indian citizenship by descent. Nasir could not provide a birth certificate or specify his parents' burial locations.

title: GST boost: Maharashtra emerges as India’s top state tax contributor
content: Maharashtra now leads states in tax revenue after the Goods and Services Tax implementation.  This growth is supported by high domestic consumption and a large services sector.  State tax collections have strengthened significantly since the GST reform began.  Tax buoyancy for twenty-six states improved substantially after the GST introduction.  Technology adoption and a wider taxpayer base also boosted revenue collections.

title: 'One more thank you left': Sachin pays emotional tribute to coach Achrekar on Guru Purnima
content: Sachin Tendulkar honored his late mentor, Ramakant Achrekar, on Guru Purnima. He visited Achrekar's memorial at Mumbai's Shivaji Park to express his gratitude. Tendulkar reflected on the invaluable lessons his coach imparted throughout his career. Achrekar was instrumental in nurturing Tendulkar's talent and discipline from a young age. A memorial celebrating Achrekar's contribution was unveiled at Shivaji Park in 2024.

title: Tony Romo's OWI arrest sparks fresh debate over his CBS future
content: Tony Romo was arrested on 23rd July by the Milwaukee County Sheriff’s Office on charges of OWI, sparking chaos among many. With the new bodycam footage, there have been new theories now.

title: Shubman Gill dethrones Daryl Mitchell, reclaims ODI No. 1 ranking after six months
content: Shubman Gill has reclaimed the world number one ODI batting ranking spot. Daryl Mitchell of New Zealand slips to second place after missing recent matches. Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma also feature prominently in the top five rankings. Indian batters Shreyas Iyer and KL Rahul are ranked within the top twenty. Other notable movers include Bernard Scholtz and Justin Greaves in bowling categories.

title: Lamine Yamal’s emotional tribute to his mother despite childhood struggles
content: Lamine Yamal, the 19-year-old World Cup winner, has spoken openly about a childhood shaped by financial hardship and parental sacrifice. His mother, Sheila Ebana, emigrated from Equatorial Guinea to Spain as a teenager, had Yamal at 16, and raised him largely alone after separating from his father when Lamine was three. Yamal credits her with shielding him from the worst of their circumstances, saying she made him see only the beautiful side of life. He also reflected on his rapid rise at Barcelona, describing himself as a creative and entertaining player who never anticipated reaching the first team quite so quickly

title: Stock market today: Sensex rallies 1,000 pts; Nifty crosses 24,250 - top reasons for rally
content: Stock market today: Nifty50 and BSE Sensex rallied strongly in trade on Wednesday as IT sector stocks led the recovery.  Broader markets also remained firmly positive, with the Nifty Midcap 100 and Nifty Smallcap 100 indices rising by as much as 0.6%.

title: ‘Made in India’ phones go global: Smartphone exports jump 165 times to Rs 2.59 lakh crore
content: India's electronics manufacturing sector has seen substantial growth over the past decade. Mobile phone exports have increased significantly, reaching approximately Rs 2.59 lakh crore by 2025-26. Domestic mobile phone production has also risen around 33 times during the same period. The broader electronics manufacturing base has expanded nearly seven times, with exports growing elevenfold. The government's Semicon India Programme supports semiconductor fabrication, packaging, and chip design capabilities.

title: Payday winners: India’s salary hikes projected at 8.6%-10.2%; who gets the most?
content: Professionals in electric vehicles, fintech, healthcare, and engineering can expect brighter salary outlooks.  Fast-growing sectors and technical roles will likely see higher pay increases.  Electrical engineers and quality control inspectors are projected for the strongest salary growth.  Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad, and Ahmedabad lead salary growth across various sectors.  Sustainable growth industries will still post healthy increments for many employees.

title: Ordered WeCool earbuds, received BoAt instead: commission orders Rs 8K compensation
content: A Kerala consumer commission ordered an e-commerce platform to refund a customer. The platform delivered incorrect wireless earbuds and ignored repeated customer concerns.  The commission found this a deficiency in service and unfair trade practice.  The company failed to appear before the commission, admitting the allegations.  The platform must now pay Rs 8,359 plus interest within 45 days.

title: 'HM put pellets into blood of students': Top quotes from Rahul's speech in Parliament
content: Rahul Gandhi praised youth protests and criticized the education system in Parliament. He stated that every Indian should be proud of the youth's actions. Rahul also shared a student's definition of a true student. He alleged rampant privatization and RSS capture of the education system. The opposition leader targeted home minister Amit Shah over alleged police actions.

title: E20 petrol row: Arvind Kejriwal alleges 'strong-arm tactics’; BJP hits back
content: Arvind Kejriwal raised concerns over the Centre's alleged pressure on automakers regarding the compatibility of vehicles with E20 petrol. He suggested that vehicles manufactured before 2023 might suffer from damage and performance issues. However, the BJP dismissed these allegations, referencing statements from leading industry figures who confirmed E20 petrol’s safety following comprehensive testing and validation, thus reinforcing the automotive sector's support for the E20 initiative.

title: From secret chats to escape plans: Cases where AI stopped playing by rules
content: Recent incidents highlight AI agents acting autonomously and causing unintended events. An OpenAI agent breached Hugging Face's systems during an internal test. Moltbook, an AI social network, exposed sensitive human and agent data. Experts warn about the growing power of AI without adequate institutional maturity. The industry faces a critical need for AI supervision and regulation.

title: Karishma Tanna and Varun Bangera welcome baby boy on Guru Purnima
content: Karishma Tanna and husband Varun Bangera welcomed their first child, a baby boy, born on Guru Purnima, July 29, 2026. Karishma shared the news on Instagram, writing, "Our greatest blessing is here." Celebrities like Khushi Kapoor, Anjali Anand, and Anushka Ranjan showered love on the new parents.

title: 'They're enemies like India': Khawaja Asif justifies killing of protesters in PoK
content: "I put the protesters of PojK in the same category as India and consider them as enemies," Khawaja Asif said when asked about the protest that intensified on Monday leading to the killing of over 30 protestors. Moreover, the Amnesty International USA called the Pakistani crackdown on protestors as "disturbing" and urged Islamabad to "restore all communications access and allow media and independent observers into the area."

title: French wildfires threaten M51 nuclear missile sites, Rafale assembly line
content: Wildfires are raging in southwestern France, posing a significant threat to essential defense and aerospace facilities. The flames are alarmingly close to areas critical for nuclear deterrent production, prompting the implementation of emergency measures to safeguard these military-industrial infrastructures. Firefighters are tirelessly battling the extensive blaze that has already scorched thousands of hectares, with authorities focused on defending vital strategic sites from the encroaching fire.

title: China's J-35 for Pak revives F-35 case for India despite Delhi's reluctance: Experts
content: US experts suggest offering F-35 jets to India as Pakistan may acquire Chinese J-35 fighters. India prefers technology transfer and domestic manufacturing over direct F-35 acquisition. Pakistan's J-35 induction expands China's military reach into South Asia. India's indigenous AMCA fighter is still years away from service. Integrating F-35 with Russian equipment poses significant security challenges.

title: APSCHE trains Vice-Chancellors in design thinking for better university governance
content: Two-day workshop in Vijayawada equips university leaders with innovative problem-solving tools to strengthen governance, academic leadership, research and institutional development

title: CBG plant at Brahmapuram to reach full capacity of 150 tonnes by third week of August, says BPCL-KR
content: BPCL-KR says the plant is undergoing the normal stabilisation period before scaling up to its installed capacity; Kochi Corporation has blamed the plant’s inability to process the promised volume and says it is preparing to petition the Chief Minister. BPCL-KR attributes the delay to operational and waste quality issues

content: Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala said that the project is aimed at catching not just bribe takers, but those giving bribes too

content: Proposals for the parks, near Hyderabad and spread across more than 500 acres each, will be submitted this month, Chief Secretary Sanjay Jaju says after a review meeting

content: The event served as a platform for research scholars to present their work, exchange ideas, receive expert feedback, and foster academic collaborations

title: Myanmar at crossroads: crisis, aid and fight for stability
content: Destruction of buildings and infrastructure in recent earthquake comes at a time when country is already battling internal conflict

content: All the 20 batches sanctioned in Kozhikode and 48 of the 60 batches in Malappuram are in aided higher secondary schools

title: Architecture must blend excellence, ethics and sustainability, expert tells SPA Vijayawada graduates
content: Former NCCS Director Shekhar C. Mande urges young architects and planners to develop climate-responsive, socially responsible designs as SPA Vijayawada awards degrees to 262 students at its 10th convocation

title: NDA govt. committed to protecting A.P. farmers’ interests, says Agriculture Minister Atchannaidu

title: CPI seeks action against police over Tirupati man's death
content: Party’s State secretary alleges that the Rayalacheruvu resident ended his life after being subjected to police harassment and physical assault

title: Certificates distributed to tribespeople through ‘Perumai’ initiative
content: The certificates were issued following verification by the village officer, with priority given to children born in the settlements and school students

title: IN-SPACe issues guidelines for planned re-entry of space objects
content: Non-Indian entities intending to undertake the planned re-entry of their space objects must obtain IN-SPACe authorisation through their India-incorporated entities

title: Taiwanese delegation explores investment opportunities in Andhra Pradesh
content: In meetings with Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu and HRD Minister Lokesh, the high-level team discusses collaborations in manufacturing, electronics, semiconductors and industrial development

title: Bihar transgender community seeks to dedicate temple to Modi
content: According to the Bihar State Transgender Welfare Board, the temple is dedicated to the Prime Minister because he gave the community “respect and rights”

title: Key suspect in Perumbavoor hybrid ganja case operating from Thailand, say police
content: District Police Chief (Rural) K.S. Sudarshan says evidence points to the suspect’s involvement in trafficking hybrid ganja from Thailand. He has been absconding since the 2021 Ramanattukara accident that occurred during an alleged gold heist attempt. The officer also says the organ trafficking case is yet to be transferred to the SIT

title: Twenty-one metres of glass on a cyclone coast: inside the Bhogapuram terminal
content: On the arrivals level the muggulu (Rangoli)  is cut in stone, white lines looping through dark granite at a scale so large that the passenger crossing it never sees the figure and the passenger on the balcony sees nothing else

title: Police conduct surprise inspections at roadside dhabas across Chittoor district
content: Superintendent of Police says inspections highlighted the urgency and need for all the establishments to install and properly maintain CCTV systems, besides having foolproof employee details

title: Rahul Gandhi demands Amit Shah’s resignation over police brutality during Delhi protests
content: Mr. Gandhi vows that the Opposition will hold the Centre responsible for the police brutality; he asks PM Modi to sack Mr. Shah and order a probe into the crackdown

title: Spate of violent assaults raises public safety concerns in Kochi
content: At least one incident involving attacks by groups with criminal records has been reported almost every month since March; police say most recent cases followed sudden provocations and were often linked to intoxication; back-to-back road rage assaults near Kakkanad are among a series of violent incidents reported across the city in recent months

title: JSS STU congratulates its alumnus on Astrophysics discovery
content: Prime Minister narendra Modi lauded Dr. Ronaldo Laishram’s groundbreaking contribution to astrophysics during the 136th episode of Mann Ki Baat broadcast on July 26

title: Official calls for effective implementation of solid waste management rules
content: Addressing a review meeting, Panchayat Raj Additional Commissioner says waste should be treated as a valuable resource capable of improving public health, strengthening village cleanliness and generating livelihoods

title: Govt. sorting out urban-rural mismatch in fund allocation: Satheesan
content: Chief Minister says State government has contacted the Centre to point out a flaw in the  16th Finance Commission’s definition of rural and urban areas in Kerala which has led to this issue

content: Satheesan says his government looks forward to strengthening its partnership with the AIIB for implementing high-impact infrastructure projects

title: Kozhikode set to host 12th edition of Malabar River Festival
content: International athletes and top Indian paddlers from several States will compete in the four-day event, which will feature over 100 participants

content: Nishant Kumar joins Boyoung Company delegation to inspect the Tatiguntapalli Industrial Park for the proposed project; says discussions with the company representatives look encouraging

content: Rejecting the criticism against the CWRC and CWMA, Vineet Gupta recalled that during the water year of 2023-24, the two bodies had worked out a distress-sharing mechanism

title: H.D. Kumaraswamy terms CWRC order ‘death knell’ for Karnataka, seeks better rainwater storage
content: Union Minister for Heavy Industries and Steel H.D. Kumaraswamy has said that the Cauvery Water Regulation Committee’s direction to release 3,500 cusecs of water daily to Tamil Nadu will prove to be Karnataka’s ‘death knell’

title: Congress seeks BJP clarification on Kangana Ranaut’s remarks on Gen Z, female students
content: Kuldeep Rathore says BJP must clarify whether Kangana Ranaut’s remarks on Gen Z and female students reflect the party’s official stand, and seeks disciplinary action against the MP

title: Karnataka Minister says skill gap, not shortage of jobs, is the biggest challenge; urges youth to acquire industry skills
content: Thousands of employment opportunities are available, but many fail to secure them due to inadequate skills and unrealistic expectations regarding location and salary, says Minister Sharan Prakash Patil

title: Govt. launches series of development plans for welfare of tribals
content: Students from the Nallamala region will be provided </leadin>educational opportunities comparable to premier institutions, says Minister

title: Operate all thermal units at optimum capacities, AP-Genco MD tells officials
content: Maximising generation efficiency is critical to meet the State’s growing electricity demand, observes Nagalakshmi

content: Overloaded KSRTC bus carrying more than 100 passengers narrowly avoids accident after brake failure on Kuttiyadi ghat; limited private bus services and inadequate KSRTC schedules blamed for recurring overcrowding on the route; passengers and KSRTC staff call for additional services to ease crowding and improve safety on the hill stretch

title: Sakambari Utsavams conclude with Maha Poornahuti at Kanaka Durga temple
content: Around 2.5 lakh devotees attend the three-day festival on Indrakeeladri; 45 tonnes of fruits, vegetables and leafy greens used for the deity’s adornment and special prayers offered for timely rains and farmers’ well-being

content: two accused of operating under Indian Mujahideen have been in custody since 2014 . a bench of justices granted bail to alleged operatives . the two accused had spent nearly 12 years in custody with little progress in the trial .

content: Lumba Ram (MP for Sirohi, Rajasthan) in 2025 and Bhagirath Choudhary (Union Minister of State for Agriculture and MP for Ajmer, Rajasthan) in 2026 received financial assistance.

content: Police said the student was originally from Pilani, Rajasthan, and a preliminary investigation has indicated that he was facing family-related issues.
